claim: For a finite equivariant positive contraction, harmonic-mean lower and complementary upper iid domination hold. In the strict case the minimum full-rest conditional presence probability is 1/(Q^(-1))_ee, not the Schur-complement odds.
remaining_gap: Harmonic mean can be strictly below FK. Full-rest conditional bounds alone cannot prove the conjecture.
